rules.title: Release process is a delivery bottleneck
rules.detail: Deployment automation is below the level required for safe, frequent release.

rules.title: Change confidence depends on manual verification
rules.detail: Without automated coverage, sponsored release decisions rest on opinion.

rules.title: Sponsored work has no defined outcome
rules.detail: Investment cannot be defended without a named outcome and measure.

rules.title: Sponsor reporting is hand-assembled
rules.detail: Manual reporting delays and distorts the sponsor view.

rules.title: Work in progress is unmanaged
rules.detail: Unlimited WIP hides true capacity from the sponsor.

definitions.name: Executive Sponsorship Risk
definitions.description: Sponsorship is not converting intent into decisions, visibility or ownership.
definitions.rationale: Fires when weak sponsorship or governance theatre is present.
definitions.explanationTemplate: {count} supporting signal(s) — {signals} — indicate limited executive engagement and ineffective governance participation.

definitions.name: Governance Effectiveness Risk
definitions.description: Governance forums report activity but provide no assurance.
definitions.rationale: Requires both governance theatre and an assurance gap.

definitions.name: Decision Latency Risk
definitions.description: Decisions escalate late and dependencies stall waiting for direction.
definitions.rationale: Fires on the slow decision making signal.
definitions.explanationTemplate: Decision latency evidenced by {signals} at {confidence} confidence.

definitions.name: Benefits Realisation Risk
definitions.description: Investment is proceeding without measured benefit realisation.
definitions.rationale: Fires when benefits tracking is absent.

definitions.name: Delivery Predictability Risk
definitions.description: Plans, risks and leadership capacity are not dependable enough to forecast delivery.
definitions.rationale: Needs at least two of the planning, risk and leadership signals.
definitions.explanationTemplate: {count} of 3 predictability signals are present ({signals}), so delivery forecasts cannot be relied upon.

definitions.name: Engineering Assurance Risk
definitions.description: Release confidence rests on manual verification and unmanaged technical risk.
definitions.rationale: Fires on engineering fragility or a governance assurance gap.

definitions.name: Sponsorship Operating Well
definitions.description: No sponsorship, governance or decision-making risk signals were inferred.
definitions.rationale: Passes only when none of the core risk signals fired.
definitions.explanationTemplate: No sponsorship, governance or decision-making risk signals were present.

definitions.name: Portfolio Visibility Risk
definitions.description: Portfolio reporting does not give the sponsor a dependable view.

definitions.name: Change Adoption Risk
definitions.description: Delivered change is unlikely to be adopted by the business.
definitions.rationale: Fires on the change adoption signal.

definitions.name: Systemic Delivery Risk
definitions.description: Risk is present across sponsorship, governance, planning and engineering simultaneously.
definitions.rationale: Fires when four or more core risk signals co-occur.
definitions.explanationTemplate: {count} concurrent risk signals ({signals}) indicate systemic delivery risk rather than isolated weaknesses.

definitions.name: Insufficient Assessment Evidence
definitions.description: Too much of the assessment is unanswered for confident reasoning.
definitions.rationale: Fires when exactly the evidence-completeness signal is present.

definitions.name: Delivery Leadership Capability Confirmed
definitions.description: Leadership and decision ownership are both operating at a mature level.
